title: The Catholic Encyclopedia
edition: 1907-1912, 15 main volumes + Index volume (1914) + Supplement volume (1922)
corrections_note: 360,872 by the cleanup engine + 119 by the sentence context pass + 159 by the proofread pass; 7 bad corrections reverted against the second scans.
source: HathiTrust record 000867126; Internet Archive catholicencyclop0001char-0017 (Robert Appleton Company, New York). Second scans used as a check only, never merged.
pages_note: Article page numbers are the exact printed folios where the leafmap could anchor them (vol. 1 validated against 3 printed pages read as images, all exact; AACHEN leaf 24 = p. 1). A few articles carry an interpolated folio. Vol. 10 numbering starts at p. 6, not p. 1.
flag_note: words.json 5th element: 0 = main volumes 1-15, 1 = vol. 16 Index, 2 = vol. 17 Supplement. Letter-file entries carry 'idx': 1 for Index articles and 's': 1 for Supplement articles (the 's' flag keeps its Chambers's meaning).
key_note: Keys are lowercase with non-alphanumerics stripped, as in the Britannica/Chambers's builds. 19 headwords carry a fused folio number ('2 Act', '93 Augustine', '60 Brescia', ...); the leading digits are stripped from the KEY only, so the entry files under the real headword — the display headword is kept verbatim.
honest_limits: Vol. 13 holds a 195,103-word monster ('Smogrphiae' — the Rosminian System article and its tail, headword garbled); vol. 9 a 139,403-word monster (McSherry); vol. 13 a 110,056-word monster (S. Cecilia); vol. 17 a 104,228-word monster (Jugoslavia); vol. 13 a 102,719-word monster ('Sgm Nvingwav Gnv Lvino'). Vols. 6 and 9 tails after the biblical place-name gazetteer are preserved in back matter, not split into articles (vol. 6 back matter 451,269 words; vol. 9 back matter 225,179 words). Vol. 17 is only 49 articles — many supplement articles are still merged (320,806 words of unsplit supplement text in back matter). Vol. 16 is the Index: 55 supplementary articles at the start; the general index itself (1,496,687 words) is back matter by design. The 2026-11-27 no-omission audit restored 296 wrongly-changed readings (277 phrase restorations, mostly Latin -io endings the corrector had anglicized, plus 19 token mappings) and recovered 22 dropped articles (entries 8,997 to 9,019): vol. 4's 'Clandestinity' (p. 1) and vol. 1's 'Aeneas of Gaza' (p. 172) are now present as their own entries, along with the vol. 1 merged-run split (17 entries) and the vol. 4 folio-1 replacement articles (Clare of Assisi, Clarendon, Clare of Montefalco, Clare of Rimini); vol. 4 folio 1 was replaced from the same-edition second scan. No disagreement case was found for this book (nothing changed because the corrector disagreed with the writer). 10 items remain ambiguous/unrecovered as logged in audit-restorations.md section 5 — left as printed, not guessed. 424 headwords occur more than once (same headword in different volumes). ~15,000-17,000 distinct unknown tokens per volume remain in unresolved.md (mostly real words: Latin, Greek, French, German, proper names).
